lines.text: I figured it out! My business name needs more keywords!
Apex Roofing! Best Brooklyn Roofer! Emergency Roof Repairs! 24/7! Cheap! Number one!
lines.why: each phrase is typed into the name field as he says it
victory + crown; the name keeps growing into a ribbon

lines.text: Wait... why is my business name taking over the screen?
lines.why: the ribbon wraps round him; the Maps Assistant arrives, looks at the name, then him; ~0.5 s pause

lines.text: Sir... that's not a business name. That's an entire search results page.
Your listing needs a name, not a hostage situation.
Google's rules require your real business name. Unnecessary keywords can put your profile at risk.
Adding keywords to your Google Business Profile name isn't a compliant ranking shortcut.
Put your services, hours, and locations in the proper fields.
Use the name your business is genuinely known by. Keep your categories, services, and business information accurate.
So... my business name should just be Apex Roofing?
lines.why: a small approving reaction from the assistant

lines.text: Then what am I supposed to do with the other forty-seven words?
Try putting those extra words on your website. In actual sentences.
lines.why: pause after the punchline; then 'YOUR BUSINESS NAME ISN'T A KEYWORD LIST.' before the lockup
